## Reference Behavior

Record the exact public signature, defaults, wire request/response, native

## Flutter Behavior

Record every confirmed difference and its source location. Distinguish an
intentional Dart adaptation from a defect.

## Required Outcome

- [ ] Stable tracker issue ID and exit criteria.
- [ ] Public API and capability parity.
- [ ] Pigeon/iOS/Android contract parity.
- [ ] Model, default, unit, and error parity.
- [ ] Lifecycle and failure behavior verified.
- [ ] Executable tests and required local platform evidence attached.
- [ ] Release Readiness Tracker updated.

## References

Add immutable source links, symbols, and test/evidence identifiers.
